errors.text_span: Ein hellgrüner Balken steht für das „Welt-BIP“, ein blassgrüner Balken für den „Welthandel“
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the colors: the dark green bar represents 'Welt-BIP' and the light green bar represents 'Welthandel', as shown in the legend.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the average percentage values of Welt-BIP, Welthandel, Exporte Deutschland, and Industrieproduktion Deutschland.
The description does not mention that the legend is located below the chart.
The description does not mention the consistent order of the bars (dark green, light green, dark blue, light blue) across all decades.
